name_input: AEROTECH EQUIPMENTS AND PROJECTS PRIVATE LIMITED
export_evidence: No export record found. The only customs rows retrieved are IMPORT rows where the company is the buyer/importer: "2025-12-10 | AEROTECH EQUIPMENTS AND PROJECTS PRIVATE LIMITED | TC NEXT MALAYSIA SDN BHD | TERAL WATER PUMP : ASVMG25L23-51.1- | TUGLAKABAD ICD, India | Klang, MALAYSIA | 84138190 | 7760722" (source: importkey.com/countries/india/aerotech-equipments-and-projects-private-limited). Direction is Malaysia -> India (origin Klang, destination Tuglakabad ICD), i.e. inbound, not an export shipment. Counter check: page header states "Total Shipments 80 Records detected", "Trading Partners 1", "Ports 2"; rows actually visible in the free view = 5 shipment lines (all same B/L 7760722, same date 2025-12-10, HS 84138190) plus 2 supplier rows (Teral Asia Limited - 10 shipments; ANHUI COLGAR MACHINERY MANUFACTURING CO LIMITED - 3 shipments) and 1 buyer row (TC NEXT MALAYSIA SDN BHD - 71 shipments). So 80 claimed vs 5 rows seen; the 71+3+10 sub-totals are consistent with the 80 total but all are import-side. No export B/L, no outbound destination, no export HS line was observed.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award, contract or annual-report split could be retrieved. web_search returned no results (backend error: "searx: <urlopen error [Errno 111] Connection refused>") and volza.com, eximpedia.app and trademo.com all returned HTTP 403 Forbidden, so domestic supply evidence could not be checked. Registered address visible in customs data: "PLOT NO. 189, ECOTECH EXTN-I" (Greater Noida / Ecotech extension area), which is an address record only, not supply evidence.
note: Declared HS 841459 (fans/blowers) does not match the only HS codes actually observed in customs records: 84138190 (pumps) on the import rows, and the related entity name "TERAL-AEROTECH FANS PRIVATE LIMITED" appears in the supplier address block. Per project rule 3 this is NOT grounds for rejection: company stays in the base, actual observed code is 84138190 on the retrieved rows, verdict would be accepted_hs_corrected with this caveat. Shipment factuality (rule 5): real customs activity IS documented, but only as IMPORTS of Teral water pumps from TC Next Malaysia Sdn Bhd via Klang into Tuglakabad ICD, latest 2025-12-10, B/L 7760722. No trace of any export shipment was found, and no trace of domestic supply (GST turnover, GeM/CPPP tenders, contracts) could be verified because search was down and the paid trade portals blocked access. Revenue and export volume: null - not public in the free views, not estimated. Role: appears to be importer/distributor of pumps (possibly manufacturer_trader via the Teral-Aerotech Fans JV), but that is inference from the counterparty naming, not a verified fact. Two other slug variants (aerotech-equipments-projects-private-limited, aerotech-equipments-and-projects-pvt-ltd) returned empty/placeholder pages with no records, so the single populated slug above is the only evidence source.
